pages.text: $(bold)Malevolent Shrine$(): once its kitchen is open, all things are but ingredients.$(br2)Drains radius x40 curse power per second (twice the cost of Self-Embodiment of Perfection). Every 2 ticks it unleashes a slash against every creature and player inside except the one who opened it:$(li)Ignores invulnerability frames; armor / shields still reduce it$(li)Damage per slash = (1 + (curse output level + curse affinity/10)/10) x (current attack damage + curse output level x5) x 5%$(li)Each slash also triggers material combat traits$(li)Leaves redstone-dust blood at the victim's feet (mining it yields nothing)
